name: Kulob

queries.query: Kulob Tajikistan official cadastral parcel map registry GIS land cadastre
queries.result: First-party discovery identified Tajikistan Geoportal as a public map portal describing location lookup for homes, land parcels and objects, and the State Committee for Land Management and Geodesy as the national cadastre/registration custodian. No Kulob-local public parcel API or openly documented parcel geometry endpoint was qualified.

queries.query: Кӯлоб Тоҷикистон кадастр харита қитъаи замин расмӣ; рақами кадастрии Кӯлоб геопортал
queries.result: Расмии ҷустуҷӯ Geoportal.tj-ро ёфт, ки ҷойгиршавӣ ва рақами кадастрии объектҳои бақайдгирифташударо шарҳ медиҳад; қонунгузорӣ низ ворид кардани ҳудуди қитъаи замин ба харитаи кадастриро пешбинӣ мекунад. Хадамоти оммавии маҳаллии Кӯлоб бо посухи беном ID-и қитъа ва геометрия тасдиқ нашуд.

registryEvidence.custodian: The State Committee for Land Management and Geodesy is evidenced as the national authority for land cadastre, geodesy, cartography and state registration of immovable property. Geoportal.tj is described as a public national map portal.
registryEvidence.scopeNote: National custodian and portal evidence do not establish a Kulob-local registry endpoint or citywide open parcel coverage; registryFound remains null. The public baqaydgiri.tj page is an official registration/encumbrance list, not a parcel geometry viewer.

parcelDiscovery.note: No safe anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry response was obtained. The exact WUP point was preserved and was not shifted or used as a citywide absence test.

requestOutcomes.outcome: TLS verification failed because the server certificate was expired. No certificate exception was authorized or used; current JavaScript/configuration, schema, CRS and parcel response could not be inspected.
HTTP 301 redirect to https://geoportal.tj/; the redirected HTTPS request then failed normal TLS verification.

HTTP 200. Official public registration/encumbrance list exposes search controls and cadastral-number text for listed records, but no parcel polygon, map service, public geometry schema, or Kulob-local parcel endpoint was exposed by the inspected page. Unsafe owner/address details were not retained.

HTTP 200 via first-party discovery. Official description identifies the State Committee's national land-management, cadastre, geodesy, cartography and immovable-property-registration remit; it provides no anonymous parcel geometry endpoint.
HTTP 200 via first-party discovery. Official enterprise page describes digital map and plan production, including city plans, but no open parcel API, native parcel schema or CRS was exposed.

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier only if publicly exposed and source-proven
uncertainty: The Geoportal may contain public parcel data but could not be inspected under normal TLS verification because its certificate was expired.
A national custodian and general portal description are not evidence of citywide Kulob parcel coverage.
No exact-point hit, TLS failure, unavailable viewer or absent geometry response is treated as citywide cadastral absence.
No parcel polygon is retained because no safe source geometry and stable native identity were verified.
